name: Decoding Love
source:
You start a new semester of collage,  desperate to just pass your classes and graduate  until a couple people change you're mind on what you Really want from your collage experience.

[From [url=https://bagofants.itch.io/decoding-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你开始了新学期的大学生活，迫切地想通过课程并毕业，直到有几个人改变了你的想法，让你改变了你真正想要从大学经历中得到什么的想法。

[来自[url=https://bagofants.itch.io/decoding-love]Itch.io[/url]]
